local_checks.invariant: POST /api/zip and the admin log zip add no new root cause beyond the confirmed zipstream fingerprints; quota, disk and name checks hold
local_checks.result: POST /api/zip consumes its own stream with Bun.write, so no unread-body codec slot is held. collectZipItems (src/zip.ts:101) is a synchronous unbounded walk, the same cause as zipstream-no-yield-eventloop-stall-large-tree. ensureSpace(upper), holdNow(q, upper) and commit(statSync size) bound the result. need() requires zip and write. The log zip is admin-only with a fixed file list.

local_checks.invariant: Local sandbox checks, run twice: (1) stall on 20,000 one-byte files; (2) 4 concurrent server-side zips plus batch zip plus backup; (3) quota near full
local_checks.result: (1) POST /api/zip on 20,000 one-byte files returned 200 in 3.4 s (run 1) and 3.6 s (run 2) with 0 ticks of a 10 ms timer, so the event loop stalled for the whole request. This is the same no-yield stall as zipstream-no-yield-eventloop-stall-large-tree, reached through POST /api/zip (variant, no new fingerprint). (2) 4 concurrent 4x3MB zips, a batch zip and a backup all returned 200 in 92-379 ms; a solo zip took 12-23 ms before and after. They run one after another on the single thread and nothing waits on codec slots, so nothing is beyond the existing fingerprints. (3) Quota 1,000,000 with 400 KB used: zip #1 returned 200 and the archive on disk was 400,271 B; zip #2 (needs 400 KB more) returned 507 quota.exceeded with no file left behind, and so did zip #3. Reported used was 800,271 and bytes on disk 800,271, so the committed usage matches the disk and the quota holds.

local_checks.invariant: Repeat run of the same checks
local_checks.result: Run 2 gave the same results: 3.6 s stall with 0 timer ticks, no slot waits, quota 507 and usage equal to disk.

parent_note: other zipStream callers were not checked as triggers. files.ts:337-343 builds a server-side archive with collectZipItems (no entry cap) for any user with zip+write; logs.ts:90 zips log files; backup.ts:581 was used only as the victim. Needs an account (guest defaults in settings.ts:90 exclude zip).
parent_hardening: POST /api/zip (src/routes/files.ts:348) is another entry to zipstream-no-yield-eventloop-stall-large-tree: any account with zip+write stalls the event loop for the whole request (measured 3.4-3.6 s, 0 timer ticks, for 20,000 one-byte files). Not a new finding. Fixing collectZipItems and the zipStream add loop (async walk, yield, entry cap) fixes every caller.

The quota hold for POST /api/zip is the sum of file sizes taken at collect time. Files that grow during the write can make the archive slightly larger than the hold. commit() records the real size, so the effect is a small overshoot only.
